Based on `docs/flows/add-endpoint.md` (which uses this exact feature as its example) and the related code docs. I haven't opened the source files, so line numbers come from the docs' anchors.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: number }`, next to `LevelUpBody:168`. Add a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST` (a flat value, or a per-level formula). The Worker owns the rule, so the cost lives here and not in the frontend. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. The handler does the following: validate the body (400); `getCharacter` (404 if missing); reject with 400 if `hp >= max_hp` (nothing to restore) or `gold < cost`; reject if the character is in combat or at 0 HP (see below); then `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })`. Return `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, cost }`. Optionally add a fixed narrative string, or `askDM` for flavor (the level-up flavor text is almost always the fallback anyway). Follow `routes/levelup.ts` and `routes/action.ts` for `appendHistory`, `loadSession`/`rebuildSession`/`saveSession`, and an `adventure_log` insert with a `system` entry such as `[Rest] …`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts:41-48` | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. No CORS change is needed. |
| `worker/src/services/character.ts` | No change. `updateCharacter:94` already whitelists `hp` and `gold`. If the rest logic is shared with other routes, extract it into a service here or in a new `services/*.ts`. |
| `worker/migrations/` | No change. `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist in `characters`. |

**Combat check:** the in-combat state lives in the KV session (`CombatState`), so the route needs `loadSession` to refuse resting mid-fight. Without that check, a player could rest to full HP during a fight.

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add `RestResponse { narrative: string; updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number }`, next to `CombatResponse:106`. Keep it in step with the Worker types by hand. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)` that posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`, in the same style as `levelUp():74`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add `rest()`, modeled on `levelUp():183`. It calls `api.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, pushes a narrative or system entry, and updates the campaign slot level if you mirror `levelUp`. Show errors from `err.error.error`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at the Inn (N gold)" button in the left column beside the Inventory button (`:9`). Disable it when `inCombat()`, when `hp === max_hp`, or when `gold < cost`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Style the button, if the existing button styles don't fit. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. Check that `rest` is called and that the character state updates. Also check the disabled states and the error path. |

No change is needed in `character-state.service.ts`: `setCharacter` already takes the server's character. No change is needed in the character sheet either, because it renders from the same signal.

## Gotchas
- The doc says the shop has no UI and that buying fails (B-02), so don't reuse the shop route for the inn.
- B-10: on death, HP stays at 0 and input stays enabled. Decide whether resting should be allowed at 0 HP. It would work as a recovery path, but it is a design choice.
- Narrative entries live only in memory on the frontend, so a reload loses the rest message. The `adventure_log` insert is what persists it.
